job_subtitle: Find roles that match your new profile.
language_selection_help: Select the language you are most comfortable speaking.
hero_subtitle: JobSathi: The Professional Voice-Powered Resume Builder, provides boosting to your career.
resume_subtitle: Ready for download in standard JSON/PDF formats.
p_2: Say the number digit by digit.
q_3: Where do you live? Or where do you want to work?
p_3: Tell your city and state, or the place you want a job.
q_4: Are you allowed to work here?
p_4: Say citizen, PR, or your visa type (for example, worker visa).
q_5: Can you use any machines or drive any vehicles?
p_5: Name what you can use: scooter, car, truck, forklift, cutting machine, etc.
q_6: Do you have any certificates from courses or training?
p_6: Tell any course or training certificate you got.
p_7: Say day shift, night shift, weekends, or rotating.
p_8: Indicate when you can begin working (e.g., immediately, 2 weeks notice).
q_9: How do you travel to work?
p_9: Share how you commute to work (e.g., personal vehicle, public transit, carpool).
q_10: Are you okay with physical work?
p_10: Can you lift heavy items, stand long, or do hard work?
q_11: How many years have you worked in this kind of job?
p_11: Say the total years. If less than 1 year, say months.
q_12: Tell me about your past jobs.
p_12: Say company, job title, what you did, and results.
q_13: What job title do you want?
p_13: Say the exact job name you want.
p_14: List the languages and how well you speak them.
q_15: Do you want full-time, part-time, or contract work?
p_16: List your main skills or tools you can use.
p_17: Give names and contact of people who can speak about your work.
p_18: Say your highest class/degree, school/college, and year.
q_20: Tell a short summary about your work.
p_20: Say what you do, your top skills, and what job you want next.
